capabilities: Rename notes to a filename template built from {{property}} placeholders
Scope rename rules to a folder and optionally to a frontmatter type value
Auto-rename files when properties change, with debouncing
Trigger a manual rename of the active note or a bulk rename of all matching files
Skip renames when properties are missing or the target filename already exists
extras: Auto-rename is off by default (debounced 800ms) and must be enabled in settings; install is manual (main.js, manifest.json, styles.css from releases) or via BRAT.
problem: When a note's canonical filename is built from properties like first name and last name, Obsidian offers no way to keep the filename in sync as those properties change.
summary: Rule-based renamer that renames notes from frontmatter properties using configurable templates, either automatically on property change or on command.
